name: Kawachinagano (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Kawachinagano city emblem in black: an outlined five-pointed flower shape enclosing a disc with strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kawachinagano, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1954.

features.role: Kawachinagano city emblem — an outlined five-pointed flower shape enclosing a disc with strokes
